column1: # Sony libmtap: the file's initialiser binds mtapman.irx's five RPC servers (0x80000901..0x80000905,
# the ones sceMtapPortOpen .. sceMtapGetModVersion call) and reports "libmtap: bind failed" and the
# libmtap.a/mtapman.irx version check, the SDK's sceMtapInit. The file's static no-op printf takes
# every libmtap error message: the release build's disabled debug print.
